reviews.text: Beware! Wouldn’t recommend. When my dog sadly passed away, they asked if we wanted a paw print and we said yes to that and they told us they would call once it was ready. After a month, they still hadn’t called so I reached out to them. I find out that they never put in the note for the paw print and he was incinerated without it. Then the girl on the phone apologizes and says if I send her photos of him, that they would create a memorial for him. Long story short, I never received the paw print nor the memorial. They don’t care about your dog here. Now I’m wondering if they even tried to save him.
